result.response:
```mike_logger_api.md
# Mike Logger API Documentation

## Overview
The Mike Logger API is a RESTful API that allows developers to interact with the Mike Logger application. The Mike Logger application is a tool for recording and managing audio logs. This API provides endpoints for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting audio logs.

## Endpoints

### Create Audio Log
**Endpoint:** `POST /api/v1/logs`
**Description:** Create a new audio log.
**Request Body:**
```json
{
  "title": "Meeting Notes",
  "description": "Notes from the weekly team meeting",
  "audio_file": "base64_encoded_audio_data"
}
```
**Response:**
```json
{
  "id": "123456789",
  "title": "Meeting Notes",
  "description": "Notes from the weekly team meeting",
  "audio_file": "base64_encoded_audio_data",
  "created_at": "2023-04-01T12:00:00Z",
  "updated_at": "2023-04-01T12:00:00Z"
}
```

### Get Audio Log
**Endpoint:** `GET /api/v1/logs/{id}`
**Description:** Retrieve an audio log by its ID.
**Response:**
```json
{
  "id": "123456789",
  "title": "Meeting Notes",
  "description": "Notes from the weekly team meeting",
  "audio_file": "base64_encoded_audio_data",
  "created_at": "2023-04-01T12:00:00Z",
  "updated_at": "2023-04-01T12:00:00Z"
}
```

### Update Audio Log
**Endpoint:** `PUT /api/v1/logs/{id}`
**Description:** Update an existing audio log.
**Request Body:**
```json
{
  "title": "Updated Meeting Notes",
  "description": "Updated notes from the weekly team meeting"
}
```
**Response:**
```json
{
  "id": "123456789",
  "title": "Updated Meeting Notes",
  "description": "Updated notes from the weekly team meeting",
  "audio_file": "base64_encoded_audio_data",
  "created_at": "2023-04-01T12:00:00Z",
  "updated_at": "2023-04-02T10:30:00Z"
}
```

### Delete Audio Log
**Endpoint:** `DELETE /api/v1/logs/{id}`
**Description:** Delete an existing audio log.
**Response:**
```json
{
  "message": "Audio log deleted successfully"
}
```

## Authentication
The Mike Logger API uses Bearer token authentication. To authenticate, include the following header in your requests:
```
Authorization: Bearer <your_access_token>
```

## Error Handling
The Mike Logger API uses standard HTTP status codes to indicate the success or failure of a request. In case of an error, the API will return a JSON response with an error message and a status code.

Example error response:
```json
{
  "error": "Audio log not found",
  "status_code": 404
}
```

## Rate Limiting
The Mike Logger API has rate limiting in place to prevent abuse. If you exceed the rate limit, the API will return a 429 Too Many Requests response with a Retry-After header indicating the number of seconds you should wait before making another request.

## Conclusion
This documentation provides an overview of the Mike Logger API and its available endpoints. For more information or support, please visit the [Mike Logger documentation](https://docs.mikelogger.com) or contact the support team.
```
